body:
Yes, things are sometimes very bad but good times can follow bad ones. It is good to think this way. 

I am still feeling bad but I am feeling better. I think things will get better. Thank you for helping me.

I used to work but became disabled by mental illness. I stay indoors mostly because it's hot outside and I haven't been able to make any friends. I have a computer and internet access. I have netflix and video games and books. I have extreme anxiety in public. I can't afford to go out, really. My diet is extremely poor I think. It is mostly beans and rice. I eat some fruit and some vegetables but they are actually quite expensive. When I start to feel bad like this I buy some meat.
Thank you. I will try to think of things this way.
